body:
This is a marketing communication. This communication is directed to professional clients in selected European markets only where MIF ELTIF is registered. Please refer to the prospectus of MIF ELTIF before making any final investment decisions. Investidng in infrastructure funds involves risks, including the potential loss of capital, illiquidity, and market fluctuations. Past performance does not predict future returns. The MIF ELTIF is not offered in the United States or to any U.S. Persons.

The prospectus, key investor information document (KID), a summary of your investor rights, and further information -including suitability and investor eligibility - are available at https://www.macquarie.com/uk/en/about/company/macquarie-asset-management/macquarie-infrastructure-fund-eltif.html.

This press release is provided for information purposes only and does not constitute an invitation, solicitation or offer to sell, or an invitation, solicitation or offer to buy, interests in any products offered by Macquarie Asset Management.

Macquarie Asset Management today announced the launch of the Macquarie Infrastructure Fund European Long-Term Investment Fund (“MIF ELTIF”), which will be available to investors in select European countries only, extending a three-decade track record of infrastructure investing for the benefit of European wealth market for the first time under the ELTIF framework.

Since launching its first infrastructure fund in 1994, Macquarie Asset Management has completed approximately 300 private infrastructure investments and over 150 realisations across sectors including roads, utilities, airports, digital infrastructure, renewable energy and waste management. Today, the platform manages over $US234 billion of infrastructure AUM1, ranks as the world’s No.1 infrastructure investment manager by assets2, and approximately 300 million people rely on Macquarie-managed infrastructure daily.3

MIF ELTIF provides wealth investors in Europe with a single access point to this platform. The fund invests alongside Macquarie Asset Management’s institutional strategies in a diversified portfolio of infrastructure equity and debt across the Americas, EMEA and Asia-Pacific4, managed by the same global team of over 400 investment professionals5 that serve the world’s largest pension funds, sovereign wealth funds and endowments.

Christopher Frost, Senior Managing Director, responsible for Macquarie Asset Management’s Global Infrastructure strategies, said:

"Four powerful megatrends, digitalisation, decarbonisation, demographics and resilience, are reshaping infrastructure and creating a compelling long-term investment opportunity. MIF ELTIF gives European wealth investors access to that opportunity through a globally diversified infrastructure portfolio designed to deliver both stability and growth across market cycles."

Henry Middleton, Head of EMEA Wealth at Macquarie Asset Management, said:

“Macquarie has spent 30 years building one of the world’s deepest infrastructure investment platforms. MIF ELTIF represents the natural evolution of that platform – giving European wealth clients access to the same calibre of infrastructure opportunities and active management that our institutional investors have benefited from for three decades.”
